description: What gains the most in the AgentGid catalog over a window you choose (any number of days, 1 to 180): AI agents and libraries by downloads, APIs by their official SDK downloads, open assets by downloads, Agent Skills packs by new GitHub stars, and MCP servers new in the window by stars. Each section says which window it really used (weekly data is rounded to whole weeks). Resources (open data, live feeds) have no ranking: the answer says how to find them with find_resources by the project's keywords and categories. Use it to suggest what a user's project could add: compare the top items with the project.

kind.description: all (default), agents, tools, apis, assets, skills, mcp, or resources (search hint, no ranking)

rank_by.description: growth (percent vs the window before, default), gain (absolute increase) or total (most in the window)

name: trending
title: What is gaining popularity
